title: FunVibes Nashville (Rooftop fire place)
description:
Located in the heart of one of the city's most desirable areas, this home is within walking distance to 12 South, and just steps away from the vibrant 8th Avenue, offering a variety of shops, restaurants, and bars. It’s also close to Wedgewood Houston, Fairgrounds, and the new soccer stadium. Enjoy easy access to downtown and Lower Broadway with just a short ride. This home boasts incredible finishes throughout and an amazing rooftop deck.

The space
This spacious home features a Keurig for your morning coffee. Sleeping arrangements include:

1 Queen bedroom on the 1st floor
1 Queen and 1 King bedroom on the 2nd floor
2 Queen bedrooms, 1 King bedroom, and 1 pullout Queen sofa on the 3rd floor.

Guest access
Keyless entry to the property via keypad. The details for the the keypad code will be sent to you prior to your reservation.

Other things to note
While the neighborhood is mostly quiet and safe this is still an urban environment and you should always remain aware of your surroundings and use common sense. We recommend that you don't leave valuables in your car and don't leave the doors and windows unlocked when you leave the house.
